fusions.name: Road's End Stamp
fusions.desc: Brings your hooves down at the end of a march, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Long Stride
fusions.desc: A long-striding kick at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Paved Miles
fusions.desc: On roads, your damage rises by 10%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
